# HEIC test image

`rainbow.heic` is the unmodified synthetic `rainbow-451x461.heic` test image from
[libheif](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic).
It exercises the actual HEVC decoder in Chromium and WebKit; changing only a
JPEG's filename would not test HEIC conversion.
